test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A vicious cycle

options.text: a situation in which one problem causes another one, making the original problem impossible to solve.
a situation in which one problem causes another one, making the first one easy to solve.
a situation in which one problem creates another one, making the original problem easy to forget.
a situation in which several problems merge and become one extremely complex problem.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"a vicious cycle"** refers to a sequence of reciprocal cause and effect events, where each problem exacerbates the next, making it increasingly difficult to resolve the initial issue. (दुष्चक्र)

 
 
• **Example: **Many people fall into **a vicious cycle of debt**, where they borrow money to pay off existing loans, only to end up deeper in debt.
